$comment: CC106/CC107 remote key map for the OP-XY. Our own structuring of community findings; every key has confidence + source keys (sources table in cc-map.json).

protocol.semantics: true down/up pair; CC106 alone leaves the key held; CC106 twice re-triggers (no toggle)
protocol.tapTiming: 500 ms hold works reliably for most keys (dawless); 200 ms used by opxy-reactive probe

firmwareStatus.status: used as CC106-only taps: B0 6A 34, B0 6A 34, B0 6A 33 (stop, stop, play)
unknown - probe required (listed as pending in docs/research/90-device-probe.md)

derivedRelations.ctrlModeCc: controller-mode CC = index + 5 for indices 0-25 and 50-71
derivedRelations.notes: three independent sources line up exactly; implies indices 10-13 are the four encoder clicks

riskClasses.ui-caution: navigation, but combos/holds/repeats can change state (tap tempo, track linking, mute shortcuts, MTP)
riskClasses.audible: makes sound; records if recording is active
riskClasses.modifier: must be released; a stuck modifier corrupts later gestures
riskClasses.destructive-in-context: can create/delete/overwrite depending on the current screen; only after agent-controlled navigation + user confirmation

knownLimits.text: direct step entry (tap note then tap step) does not commit notes via CC
step-record mode (hold record while stopped, tap notes, plus = skip) works
live recording with hold durations works
no CC exists for turning encoders remotely
holding a track key while pressing another links tracks

recipes.effect: stop twice halts all notes and sound
save project + create a version (history folder)
recipes.caution: only when the project view is known to be showing

recipes.effect: writes notes to consecutive steps of the selected track
harmless capability probe (screen changes to mix and back)

agentRules: capability-gate on a UI-only probe per firmware version
every CC106 must be followed by CC107 (held-key ledger, ~5 s cap)
release all held keys on stop, panic, disconnect and pagehide
never send M1-M4 unless the agent navigated to a known screen itself and the user confirmed
never tap tempo repeatedly; never hold one track key while pressing another
